# Da Vinci Ceramics — Mosaic Tile Collection

> A landing page concept for Da Vinci Ceramics' Mosaic Tile Collection for the Sri Lankan market.

## Main page
- https://your-vercel-domain.vercel.app/

## About this page
- The page introduces mosaic tile design inspiration and invites visitors to contact Da Vinci Ceramics.
- Visitors should contact the company directly to verify current products, stock, dimensions, finishes, suitability, prices and installation requirements.
- Gallery images in the assessment concept are illustrative inspiration images, not confirmed photos of Da Vinci Ceramics products.
